### Review

Nicely scoped, tests track the new behavior. A few small things worth tightening:

**Bugs / correctness**

1. `apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/components/HeaderQrButton.tsx:25-34` — the `isOpeningRef` guard relies on `useFocusEffect` firing again to reset. If the navigation `push` is ever swallowed (e.g. a transient guard upstream) the button becomes permanently dead until the user navigates away and back. A `setTimeout` (300–500 ms) reset alongside the focus reset would harden it without changing the happy path. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20apps%2Fmobile%2Fsrc%2Ffeatures%2FWalletConnect%2FWallet%2Fcomponents%2FHeaderQrButton.tsx%20on%20branch%20tim%2Fwa-2323-my-code-tab-reuse-sharereceive-component%2C%20add%20a%20setTimeout%20fallback%20%28~400ms%29%20alongside%20the%20useFocusEffect%20reset%20so%20isOpeningRef%20cannot%20get%20stuck%20true%20if%20the%20router%20push%20does%20not%20cause%20focus%20to%20leave.&repo=safe-global%2Fsafe-wallet-monorepo)

2. `apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/hooks/useWalletConnectScan.ts:48-70` — the focus effect doesn't consult `isActive`. If the screen first focuses while `isActive=false` (rare today since `ScanConnect` defaults to scan, but the prop now exists), the focus effect flips the camera on and the `[isActive, permission]` effect flips it off again. Tiny race; gating `setIsCameraActive(true)` on `isActive` inside the focus effect closes it. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20apps%2Fmobile%2Fsrc%2Ffeatures%2FWalletConnect%2FWallet%2Fhooks%2FuseWalletConnectScan.ts%20on%20branch%20tim%2Fwa-2323-my-code-tab-reuse-sharereceive-component%2C%20also%20require%20isActive%20before%20setIsCameraActive%28true%29%20inside%20the%20useFocusEffect%20callback%20so%20the%20focus%20path%20and%20the%20isActive%20effect%20can%27t%20fight.&repo=safe-global%2Fsafe-wallet-monorepo)

**Code quality / consistency**

3. `apps/mobile/src/features/Share/components/ShareView.tsx:47-55` — `paddingTop={30} paddingLeft={20}` and `maxWidth={260}` are raw numbers in a file that otherwise uses Tamagui tokens (`$3`, `$10`, etc.). Worth swapping to tokens (or commenting why these are fixed pixels) to keep the file consistent.

4. `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:36` — the outer track is hard-coded `width="50%"`. With the percentage-based thumb the component is otherwise generic over N options, but a 3-option control inside a half-width track is going to be cramped. Either drop the `50%` (let the caller size it) or document that the control is intentionally 2-state in this codebase.

5. `apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/components/ScanConnect.tsx:28` — `typeof insets.bottom === 'number' ? insets.bottom : 0` is dead defence; `useSafeAreaInsets()` is typed to return numbers. Also `controlClearance = insets.bottom + 64` doesn't match where the floating control actually sits (`bottom="$8"` ≈ 32 + insets.bottom + padding). The mismatch is harmless today (just extra breathing room) but a derived constant (e.g. measured + spacing tokens) would survive future tweaks better.

6. `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:29-32` — `progress` is initialised to `selectedIndex`, and the `useEffect` immediately runs `withSpring(selectedIndex, …)` on first mount. Visually fine, but it's a no-op spring on every fresh mount. A small `useRef` "skip first" or initialising the ref to `null` makes the intent clear.

**Tests**

7. `apps/mobile/src/features/Share/components/SupportedNetworksSheet.tsx` — flagged as untested in the PR description. A 5-line wrapper, but it does selector wiring (`selectSafeChains` → `getChainsByIds`); a smoke test rendering it through the store would catch future selector signature drift.

8. `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.test.tsx` — no test asserts the thumb position actually animates with the value prop. Not critical (Reanimated is hard to assert), but a snapshot or `useAnimatedStyle` mock would cover the most interesting behavior.

**Nit**

9. `apps/mobile/src/features/Share/components/SupportedNetworksList.tsx:35-44` — the `useMemo` over `filter`-twice is cheap; on tiny arrays it's noise. Either drop the memo or do a single pass partition.
